notes.title: 1.1.0 (The Modding Update)
notes.content:
Heya! This release contains an ingame dialogue editor and an extensive C# scripting framework.

That means, you can now easily write your own dialogues in game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/0c5ce81ebee07ccd96062b398237d1f01294fb09.png[/img]

We've also created a test-mod that adds Dr. Weber to the Peitho ending, who will give you a purple collar!

You can find the test mod here: [url=https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisExampleMod/]https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisExampleMod/[/url]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/11a2a7bacd8b017ac199329701934f62413a2af5.png[/img]

If you're interested in making your own mod, you can check out our instructions on how to make one here:

[url=https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisModding]https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisModding[/url]

HUGE thanks to BlauKitten for her awesome help in making this Modding SDK and pushing it over the finish line!

[list]
[*]Added Modding Support ([url=https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisModding]https://github.com/AnduoGames/ThirdCrisisModding[/url])
[*]Added a X button to the Bullet Vibrator UI
[*]Fixed a bug which locked you out of the bondage content in the north of carceburg under rare conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Third Crisis - Now Launching Out Of Early Access

Hey all! Vils here.

As you might have heard, the story of Third Crisis is now complete and we are launching the game out of Early Access on Steam! That's right, this month's release is the fabled 1.0! It has been a hell of a journey to get to this point, and we're so happy to have you along for the ride. Thank you so much for playing!

notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/36989033/9b6bbe582798a7a45aea1a40538698bdacec3ac6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to pan the camera around when not using an ability during combat.
        Right-click and drag to pan.
        Two fingers and drag on touch.

[i]This change gives more situational awareness so more informed decisions can be made.[/i]

[*] Added new overhaul to how energy is handled in combat.
        Moving no longer takes energy (speed still determines how far you can move).
        Only one energy will recharge per turn (instead of all of it).
        Jenna’s energy is now 2 (from 3).

[i]This should give party members the same aggression that only Jenna used to have.[/i]

[*] Added additional content to one of the new badgeless scenes.
[*] Added a new pinup featuring Jenna and PixieWillow.
[*] Added new Jewel CGs to replace the placeholder ones for her introduction scene.
[*] Fixed gigabrain not displaying properly.
[*] Fixed five broken animations due to engine update (thanks Unity).
[*] Fixed 40+ dialogue typos.
[*] Fixed an issue where some party members wouldn’t save their recognized state.
[/list]

notes.title: Third Crisis - Early Access Release!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Vilsa here!

[b]Third Crisis[/b] has been released to early access on Steam! It's now available for [b]$19.99 USD[/b]! There is also a free demo that you can try out before buying the game to see if it's something you'll like.

This is only the beginning of the road to completion, and we're so excited to bring you all along on the ride. You'll be hearing from us with monthly releases and you can chime in back at us with feedback that we always do our best to read up on.

[b]Two more things to go over while I've got your attention![/b]

[h1]Easter Event[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/b42bd201e08eb3030fefd54d6cda4204eb33d77c.png[/img]
We've left the Easter event running for all of you to enjoy before May begins! We'll be taking it down on May 1st, so go grab that bunny suit while you still can!

[h1]Patchnotes[/h1]
Without further ado, let's get right into what this release brings! If you're brand new to the game, you won't have to pay as much attention to this since everything will be new anyways, but we've got patch notes for returning players!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/ca9baeea8f404e070a98e12584839b596620f492.png[/img]
[b]New Pinups[/b]
[i]Follow the instructions to unlock each one in the gallery.[/i]

[b]Deepthroat Minigame[/b]
[i]Continue the Peitho storyline after the townhall storyline as normal.[/i]

[b]Rida Side Mission[/b]
[i]Complete the main storyline up to the tunnels sequence, then talk to Rida.[/i]

[b]Rida Animated Update[/b]
[i]Complete the main storyline up to the tunnels sequence, then choose Rida to sleep with.[/i]

[b]Jewel CG Update[/b]
[i]View the scene from the Gallery.[/i]

[b]Cheerleader Outfit[/b]
[i]Buy the outfit and its pasties from the Gear Shop.[/i]

[b]Vent Crawl CGs[/b]
[i]Crawl in and out of the vent in the destroyed stronghold during the prologue.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36989033/9b6bbe582798a7a45aea1a40538698bdacec3ac6.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added deepthroat minigame to the Peitho route with upgrades to buy with fuckbucks.
[*] Added six new pinups featuring new art and some unseen variants of CGs.
[*] Added side mission with Rida using the Jenna variant of the full nelson CG set.
[*] Added an initial set of about 30 achievements to unlock.
[*] Added CGs to DestroyedStronghold when crawling in and out of the vent.
[*] Added animated CG update for the Rida x Jenna sleep scene in the tunnels sequence of the main story.
[*] Added cheerleader outfit and cheerleader pasties.
[*] Added update to Jewel stage crouch CG set and added more to the scene.
[*] Added option to disable multiple autosaves.
[*] Modified Stronghold environment to be more up-to-date.
[*] Modified animated CGs to no longer render the overworld when displayed.
[*] Modified save game name input field to save when you press enter.
[*] Modified pinups to allow you to view them when first collected.
[*] Modified required Easter egg count to 20 from 30 for Easter event.
[*] Modified dialogue to tell you that you’re missing the badge if you try to leave your room without it.
[*] Modified the name of the Throb patrol task in the main story to be more clear that you need to complete the Throb patrols.
[*] Fixed memory leak with shop UI.
[*] Fixed ‘Skip to Content’ images not displaying properly on Android.
[*] Fixed ‘House4’ door being locked in Carceburg.
[*] Fixed Jenna’s vagina not being visible during one of the dark alley scenes.
[*] Fixed Peitho collar not positioning properly on Jenna’s character sprite sometimes.
[*] Fixed characters not positioned properly during the route decision cutscene in the bar.
[*] Fixed being unable to leave Jenna’s room if you have low perversion, no panties, and have the Easter outfit.
[*] Fixed cowgirl CG not displaying properly during the scene where you win against the fiends in the fight club, replaced it with animated cowgirl CG.
[*] Fixed bug where pausing the deepthroat minigame would make the guy move upward endlessly.
[*] Fixed missing name label in dialogue with Leila during Peitho route.
[*] Fixed being able to select upgrades for deepthroat even when not bought.
[*] Fixed being unable to back out of the deepthroat upgrade menu.
[*] Fixed multiple problems with the cheerleader outfit.
[*] Fixed problem with some ghost dialogues being in levels and softlocking you when the level is loaded.
[*] Fixed problem where having duplicate guard armor items would cause the fiend intro sequence to not properly put you in rags.
[*] Fixed problem where some unequipped gear could think they’re equipped and then become unusable.
[*] Fixed problem where dying on the same turn as the last Florian Oozer dying would cause the game to both win and lose, breaking some things. Now you will lose when this situation happens.
[*] Fixed some visual issues with buildings in Carceburg.
[*] Fixed Jenna and Throb walking through a building during the second Throb patrol cutscene.
[*] Fixed guards being able to see through buildings during curfew.
[*] Fixed main menu buttons not being usable via keyboard navigation.
[*] Fixed Jenna’s hair drawing under some pieces of the Guard Armor.
[*] Fixed tips that pop in from the right side of the screen never going away.
[*] Fixed a softlock when wearing the easter suit when a bar task requires you to wear the Vibrosuit.
[*] Fixed UI icons disappearing in the gallery menu.
[*] Fixed bug where Jenna’s drunk speech would overlap with each other whenever she hiccups.
[*] Fixed ‘Continue’ not always playing the latest saved game.
[*] Fixed softlock during a sublevel 2 fight when pushing a florian into a wall and defeating it.
[*] Fixed female guard prison scene 2 missing CGs.
[*] Fixed bucket from flashback level not being interactable.
[/list]
